experimental_design: Crosslinking reactions were incubated at 30 °C in a thermomixer at 300 r.p.m.
number_of_biological_replicates: Four 37.5-nM injections from four biological replicates were used for the quantification (n = 4).
number_of_fractions: For each crosslinked sample four fractions were measured in technical duplicates.
number_of_technical_replicates: For each crosslinked sample four fractions were measured in technical duplicates.
technology_type: LC–MS/MS analysis was carried out on an Orbitrap Fusion Tribrid mass spectrometer (Thermo Electron).
